issue4_items.title: Y08/Y09 SIGHASH_SINGLE overflow constant is wrong.
issue4_items.description: **Y08/Y09 SIGHASH_SINGLE overflow constant is wrong.** `Property/Y08/SighashLegacyProps.lean:99` defines `one256` as 32×`0x01`, but `Bitcoin.SigHash.singleOverflowOneB` is `0x01` followed by 31 zero bytes. The `b00`–`b04`/`d11` rows at `:442-466,831,1417` fail under `native_decide` (reproduced with `lake env lean`). Same mismatch at `Property/Y09/Property.lean:4401`. **Confirmed.**
issue4_items.initial_triage: PR #18 proposes repair; resolve conflicts, review trust changes, build and verify

issue4_items.title: BIP113 median uses lower median.
issue4_items.description: **BIP113 median uses lower median.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Block/Pow.lean:236` uses `(n-1)/2`; Core `chain.h:233-244` uses `n/2` (upper for even counts). Update `medianTimePast`, `Bip/B07/Bip113MTP.lean` fixtures, and the `mtp_even_count_lower_median` expectations.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: BIP141 `castToBool` ignores negative zero.
issue4_items.description: **BIP141 `castToBool` ignores negative zero.** `Bip/B08/Bip141Defs.lean:54` uses `bytes.any (· != 0)`; Core treats `[0x00,0x80]` as false. Port Core's loop or reuse `Bitcoin.Numeric.castToBool`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: `findAndDelete` corrupts scripts after any match.
issue4_items.description: **`findAndDelete` corrupts scripts after any match.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Interpreter/Defs.lean:548-564`: `fdLastPc2` returns the pre-match `pc2`, so the final `script.extract pc2 script.size` re-appends a suffix. `AF/PDW59/PDW59d.lean` discloses only the whole-tail case. Fix `fdLastPc2` to return the post-match `pc'`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: CVE-2012-2459 detector flags unaligned duplicates.
issue4_items.description: **CVE-2012-2459 detector flags unaligned duplicates.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Block/Connect.lean:220-223` checks every adjacent pair; Core checks only pair-aligned `hashes[2i]==hashes[2i+1]`, so `[A,B,B]` is over-rejected. Update `merkleMutationFree` and the PDW12/PDW53 characterizations.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Witness commitment uses a zero reserved value.
issue4_items.description: **Witness commitment uses a zero reserved value.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Capstone/Merkle.lean:187-195` hashes `zeroBytes 32`, not the coinbase witness reserved value. `witnessCommitmentOkReserved` exists in `AF/PDW13/WitnessCommitmentReserved.lean` but is orphaned; `commitmentGate` still uses the old definition. Wire the corrected definition through and re-prove BLK-017/SWT-030/PDW58B.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions
issue4_items.evidence: Nonzero actual reserved value binds on both public entries; zero replacement mismatches the highest selected output. PDW13 reserved-value proofs and guards rebuild (15 jobs). See validation-r05.json.

issue4_items.title: `validateBlock` omits the BIP30 gate.
issue4_items.description: **`validateBlock` omits the BIP30 gate.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Capstone/Block.lean:382` calls `applyTxs` without `bip30BlockCollision`/`bip30Enforced`; `applyBlockL` does include it. Add the gate or route through `applyBlockL`, then update `CapstoneComposePipeline`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Taproot commitment is program-blind.
issue4_items.description: **Taproot commitment is program-blind.** `spec/core/Bitcoin/Crypto/Taproot/Verify.lean:89-90` drops `program`; `OutputKey.outputKeyOk` checks only parity. Add Core's `q == program` / `CheckTapTweak` check and a wrong-program negative test; update `Audit/Z29`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Wallet selection determinism is tautological.

issue4_items.title: Wallet hash-lock acceptance is vacuous.
issue4_items.description: **Wallet hash-lock acceptance is vacuous.** `Wallet/Miniscript/Interp.lean:1233`: `hproduce` requires `bytes [0,0,0,0]`, but the dissatisfaction is 32 zero bytes, so no hash fragment can satisfy it. Use `bytes (List.replicate 32 0)`.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: Merkle 64-shape matrix omits n=64.

issue4_items.title: `blockWeight_witness_discount` has the hypothesis reversed.
issue4_items.description: **`blockWeight_witness_discount` has the hypothesis reversed.** `AF/PDW51/PDW51.lean:103` assumes `totalSize ≤ strippedSize`; witness-bearing blocks have `stripped ≤ total`. State `4*stripped + (total - stripped)` instead.
issue4_items.initial_triage: reported addressed; revalidate relevant source and regressions

issue4_items.title: SmallCurve interface is uninhabited.
issue4_items.description: **SmallCurve interface is uninhabited.** `SmallCurve/TweakCorSmall.lean:235`: `mulP_noneE` quantifies all `Nat k`, but `mulP'` only uses 16 bits. Restrict to `k < 2^16` or extend `mulP'`; otherwise the main theorems are vacuous.
